notes: Flows are BACI calendar-2024 customs flows; ranked trade tables are USDA PSD market-year 2025/26 (trader reference). Years differ.
PSD rice is on a milled basis; PSD 'Exports' are market-year (not trade-year) figures.

Customs flows cover HS 1006.10 to 1006.40. Paddy (7.95 Mt in 2024, CEPII BACI) is converted to milled equivalent with the USDA PSD milling rate of the exporter, so that flows compare with the milled-basis tables; such flows are marked Atlas estimate. Husked rice (HS 1006.20) stays at customs weight. The seaborne total and the map lanes still use customs weight.
